summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through QuadratureNexus + FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back as a closed loop to improve alignment scores — then scale this overnight with continuous autoresearch.
summary.outcome: Delivered E1-E6 (EVO capture pipeline) and E55-E63 (methodology-driven validation); discovered and fixed a critical SET-vs-additive bug in `apply_mycelium_feedback` that had been preventing multi-cycle compounding since E5; validated convergence formula `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`; confirmed EVO quality sensitivity (delta=+0.0816) and threshold crossing at lr=2.0 (delta=+0.1250); committed production fix with 11 regression tests.

repo: SurrealDB client (`surreal_client.py`) was entirely simulated — `connect()` set `self.connected = True` without any real HTTP call; probe must use `RETURN true;` not `SELECT 1;`
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary nested metadata subfields; EVO biography data must go into `result` field (option<string>) as JSON string
SurrealDB datetime fields require `time::now()` — string literals like `'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'` fail silently in SCHEMAFULL tables
TelemetryBus + JourneyWorker require explicit `bus.start()` + `worker.start()` calls; without these, events queue silently and are lost on process exit

`run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally overwrites `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call (SET semantics), wiping any Mycelium adjustments before the next deliberation sees them — experiments must use `nexus.deliberate()` directly to preserve calibration
The Gemini worktree (`.gemini/worktrees/`) is automatically cleaned up; never rely on it for persistent code — commit or copy to main repo immediately
Pre-commit Playwright hook runs unconditionally (no `files:` filter) and requires a running Next.js server at localhost:3000; add `files: \.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$` to gate it on UI file changes
7 specialist agents defined in CLAUDE.md had no corresponding markdown files, causing the `/agents` A2A endpoint test to fail with a registry discovery error
pyproject.toml had unresolved merge conflicts between HEAD and `isolated/session-oom-modularity` that blocked all `uv run` commands

The Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack can enter a silent failure state where all evaluation prompts return empty strings (but arithmetic like `2+2=` still works) — functional probe required before trusting LLM mode

code.finding: E57 fix: `apply_mycelium_feedback` was using SET semantics (`self._score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`), causing cycle 2 to replace cycle 1's calibration with a smaller value (decay). Fix: added `_mycelium_calibration` dict to `__init__`, changed to additive accumulation `self._mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; self._score_adjustments[vt] = self._mycelium_calibration[vt]`

`_evaluate_resource` only checked `budget_available` context flag, ignoring description text entirely — extended to also check keywords ('cost', 'budget', 'efficient', 'resource', 'reduce') for +0.10 bonus, making it text-sensitive like other voices

Complete rewrite from simulation to real HTTP. Key: `_HTTP_ENDPOINT = 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/sql'`, headers need `surreal-ns: cohezion`, `surreal-db: main`, `Authorization: Basic <base64(root:root)>`. All `CREATE journey_point` statements must use `timestamp: time::now()` not string literals

Inflation bug: `run_llm_deliberation()` adjustment calculation `adj = (llm_score - base) + current_adj` accumulated per-deliberation, capping all voices at 1.0 by deliberation 3. Fixed with two-layer model: `_mycelium_calibration` holds stable cross-cycle gains, per-deliberation uses SET: `nexus._score_adjustments[vt] = (voice_scores - base) + mycelium_calib`

Spin-loop bug at session deadline: `asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=min(3600, remaining_s - 10))` passes negative float when `remaining_s < 10`, causing immediate TimeoutError and tight infinite loop. Fix: `max(30.0, remaining_s - 10)` guard plus early-exit check `if remaining_s < 30: break`

Synthesized skill format is `'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX ...'` (output of `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill`), NOT `'voice_scores=[architect=X ...]'` (input format for `ingest_evo_journeys`). Test helpers must match the synthesized output format

ManifoldEnv has 19D obs (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space. `r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position)` peaks at 1.0 when all dims=0.5 (HIHO). `hiho_time_ratio` (fraction of episode in HIHO band) is the correct quality metric — not cumulative reward, which has energy penalty that makes optimal agents sometimes score lower than naive
Agent discovery scans for markdown files in the agents directory. Agents referenced in CLAUDE.md must have corresponding `.md` files or they won't appear in `/agents` A2A endpoint

workflow: Experiments without explicit retirement criteria run indefinitely — E51 accumulated 4,786 runs with cv=0.0000 before a retirement criterion was added. Add `_check_retirement(label, keep_frac, cv_last10, n_runs)` with both 100%-keep-CV<0.05 and 0%-keep-n≥min_runs branches

Pre-specifying metric achievability prevents wasted redesigns: E54 needed 3 redesigns because `dev_ratio < 0.80` was never achievable (both conditions fully converge), and E50 spent 17 iterations on a broken metric. Write the falsification criterion before implementing

Floating-point consensus threshold comparison: `sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85` in IEEE 754 — use `result.approved` (direct comparison against class constant) as canonical threshold-crossing check, not float mean

When an experiment uses `nexus.deliberate()` directly (bypassing `run_llm_deliberation`), `_score_adjustments` are preserved and Mycelium calibration works. When using `run_llm_deliberation`, the per-deliberation SET overwrites calibration — design experiments around this constraint
The convergence formula for additive Mycelium compounding is `consensus_n = threshold − gap_0 × (1−lr/2)^n`, validated to max_error=0.00025. Use this to predict experiment outcomes before running
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulate if restarts don't kill old PIDs first — always `pkill -f script_name` and verify `ps aux | grep` before launching a new instance

Committing to a Gemini worktree only is catastrophically risky — the worktree can be cleaned up taking all uncommitted changes. The E55-E62 3500-line experiment script was lost this way; all production fixes must be committed to the main repo

The autoresearch SCHEDULE label (e.g., `'E55_mycelium'`) must match the `experiment=` string passed to `log_result` (e.g., `'E55'`) for retirement filtering to work — mismatch causes all experiments to appear active regardless of convergence
